meta.title: Files+ (@ refs, size & mtime, sorting, search, git)
meta.description: The native sidebar file tree, enhanced: an @ reference button on every row plus pinned size and modification-time columns, sortable and width-adaptive; whole-workspace quick search and locate; a git bar at the bottom (branch, recent commits, expandable, multi-repo switcher); one-click @ and reveal from file previews; a runtime toggle back to the native tree; full keyboard navigation with tree semantics.
